description: Gauge is an AI-powered energy intelligence platform that helps SMEs reduce energy waste, cut operational costs, and lower greenhouse gas emissions through real-time energy monitoring, automated digitisation of energy spend, and anomaly/wastage detection.
problem_statement: Gauge solves the problem of energy waste, leakage, theft, and poor visibility in SME energy operations. SMEs across Africa lose up to 30% of energy spend because they cannot track multi-source consumption (diesel, petrol, grid), detect anomalies, or forecast accurately. This matters because energy is one of the highest operational costs for SMEs—lack of transparency directly impacts profitability, efficiency, and climate impact.

team.justification: The founding team has strong domain expertise and complementary skills. Kingsley Oti has a background in operations and scaling, having co-founded SEND, a YC-backed startup. Sharon Nweke brings deep operational insight in energy supply chains. The team has demonstrated the ability to execute and scale operations.

company_assessment.business_model_strength: Gauge operates a SaaS model with a $100 annual subscription and optional $200 hardware package. The model is scalable and targets a large market of energy-intensive SMEs.
company_assessment.market_positioning: Gauge positions itself as an affordable, AI-driven solution for SMEs, differentiating from enterprise-focused competitors by offering multi-energy tracking and carbon-credit enablement.
company_assessment.execution_capability: The team has successfully onboarded 28 paying customers and implemented multi-site energy tracking, demonstrating execution capability.
company_assessment.strategic_vision: The company aims to expand carbon-credit monetization and strengthen distribution partnerships, indicating a clear strategic vision.

competitive_analysis.landscape_overview: The competitive landscape includes manual tracking, Galooli, and Gas360. These competitors lack unified multi-energy tracking and real-time AI analytics.
competitive_analysis.competitor_comparison: Competitors are more expensive and enterprise-oriented, lacking SME-friendly solutions and carbon-credit tracking.
competitive_analysis.positioning_assessment: Gauge differentiates by offering a comprehensive, affordable platform with AI insights and carbon-credit enablement.

red_flags: Limited brand awareness in a fragmented energy market

tam.justification: The target market is substantial, with Africa's energy expense market at $110B and $80B attributed to Sub-Saharan SMEs. Gauge's initial serviceable segment in Nigeria is $30M.
